options.description: Plumb offers the study on the band with your topic as its title, and the agent writes nothing until you accept and choose the depth. Recommended: Your words ask that the agent not have to discover how studies work, and an offer that waits for you keeps you in control of a costly step.
options.label: Offer first, agent waits (Recommended)

options.description: Plumb offers the study on the band, and the agent starts it when you accept, with no depth step.
options.label: Offer only, no depth choice

payload.question:
When you ask for a study in plain words, should plumb offer it on the band first, so you pick how deep it goes before the agent writes anything?

You said on 2026-10-25: "Study from records request leads to "I'll check how plumb builds a requested study first, since "study" is a plumb feature here" . if it is a feature, shouldnt it be builtin and not request the coding agent to discover the proejct?"
